purpose: A new confirmatory experiment, separate from the completed independent-meeting batch, designed to ensure that the key previously observed venue/exact-circumference cells are actually represented while preserving full meeting-ID disjointness, frozen B1a, PRE/result separation and no retune.

scientific_context.reason_for_new_experiment: The deterministic first-100 rule in batch3 produced only Aomori/Yahiko/Maebashi and no exact 333.3m/Kawasaki/Gifu/Toyama. A separately preregistered coverage-balanced confirmation is needed to test the pre-existing subgroup hypotheses rather than post-hoc modifying batch3.
scientific_context.aggregate_metric_warning: Because this experiment is venue-stratified by design, its overall aggregate is not a population-representative estimate. Primary inference is within preregistered venue/circumference cells and stability versus prior evidence.

meeting_diversity_rule.consequence: Every venue quota above 12 necessarily requires at least two distinct selected meeting IDs if the experiment completes.
meeting_diversity_rule.prior_meeting_exclusion: Exclude every meeting ID present in the original 100-race batch, temporal 100-race batch, and completed independent-meeting 100-race batch before any result scoring.

selection_algorithm: Process each target venue independently using the fixed venue order shown above.
Within each venue, scan dates ascending from 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-31 for a real PRE-complete meeting start; discovery uses racecard/PRE access only and never result/payout pages.
Skip any meeting ID that belongs to any prior 100-race batch.
For a discovered eligible meeting, scan day index 01 then 02 then 03 and race number 01 through 12 in ascending order.
Select each successfully parsed mandatory-PRE race until either the venue quota is filled or the meeting cap of 12 selected races is reached.
Continue to the next eligible meeting date until the fixed venue quota is filled.
If any venue quota cannot be filled within the frozen date window without violating exclusions, fail closed; do not substitute a different venue or relax a quota after result access.
primary_confirmatory_comparisons: Aomori and Yahiko stability on new meeting IDs after batch3 produced a directional reversal versus earlier batches.
Kawasaki and Gifu on fully disjoint meeting IDs because batch3 did not represent them.
Exact 333.3m Toyama on fully disjoint meetings because prior temporal evidence produced 0/16 top1 and batch3 did not represent 333.3m.
Exact 335m Maebashi on fully disjoint meetings as the intermediate exact-circumference lane.
Exact 333.3m versus exact 335m versus exact 400m descriptive performance, while explicitly noting venue stratification and unequal circumference counts.
integrity_rules: No result or payout access during meeting discovery or race selection.
PRE fields and B1a predictions must be frozen before dedicated result-page scoring.
No realtime odds required; odds are not used in this prediction-science experiment.
No post-result deletion, replacement, threshold adjustment, subgroup retune or venue substitution.
Exact official circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
Historical source pages may be outcome-bearing; evidence remains RETROSPECTIVE_KR015 and must not be upgraded to prospective.
All failure/exclusion reasons before result access are retained in the selection/prediction audit.
